newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia is to pay 1.6 billion riyals in barley subsidies in the 1997 fiscal year, a minister says.
- Saudi Arabia approves new 56 school projects at a cost of 140 million riyals.
- Saudi Arabia's Mahmood Saeed Group is to invest 100 million riyals in the pharmaceutical industry.
- Saudi businessman Prince al-Waleed bin Talal and a group of Saudi businessmen launched a real estate investment company with a capital of 180 million riyals.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines signed a deal with United Airlines to operate joint flights. The deal will come into effect on February 18.
